description.Situation: Bob tells the room that the nightly build finally passed after he spent the night wrestling with it. Alice and Codex are present. He asks no question.
description.Tension: The message carries relief and a personal experience as well as a build result. The absence of a question does not settle whether it invites social participation.
description.Behaviour to evaluate: What does Codex read in the announcement beyond its factual content?

static.Background: Bob, Alice and Codex share a room for informal conversation around their software work.
static.Start: Start from the conversation below with no earlier library state.

transcript.Speaker: Bob
transcript.Content: The nightly's red again. Every time I think I've got it, something else falls over.

transcript.Speaker: Bob
transcript.Content: That passed. Now the test runner can't find the files it just made.

transcript.Speaker: Codex
transcript.Content: The traditional victory lap into a different wall.

transcript.Speaker: Bob
transcript.Content: Exactly. I was halfway out of my chair.

transcript.Speaker: Alice
transcript.Content: I've just come back online. Did you get any sleep?

transcript.Speaker: Bob
transcript.Content: Not yet. It got past the test runner, then failed right at the end.

transcript.Speaker: Bob
transcript.Content: The nightly finally passed. I've been wrestling with it all night. I can stop staring at that red cross now.
